title: Interrupted-session preflight deadlines and soft-cancel handshake
author: Priya Varma
ci_checks: go test ./... -> pass (1 retry); golangci-lint -> pass; integration e2e -> pass; load perf quick-run -> warning (~1.8% tail latency increase under pathological reconnects)
release_notes: Adds preflight session deadline negotiation and soft-cancel handshake to improve resumability and prevent premature server aborts under transient network issues.
description: Context: We see customer outages where short client disconnects (cellular flaps, mobile backgrounding) trigger server-side hard aborts because the server enforces a conservative per-request processing deadline. Those hard aborts cause tool-call duplication, KV cache invalidation, and poor UX for resumed streams. This change adds a lightweight preflight deadline negotiation and a soft-cancel handshake so short disconnects can be treated as transient and resumed when safe. Motivation: Improve streaming resiliency and OpenAI-compatible semantics for client disconnects while preserving server-side SLOs. Specifically: 1) allow a short grace window negotiated by the client and respected by the server before converting an in-flight session into a hard abort, and 2) introduce a soft-cancel handshake that marks the stream as "paused" and lets the server hold minimal execution state (KV cache, pending toolcall ids) with an attestation token. If the client reconnects and presents the token within the grace window, we resume without re-executing toolcalls. Summary of changes: Runtime: add SessionPreflight negotiation path and X-Session-Deadline-ms header handling; Protocol: define soft-cancel -> resume handshake with resume_token and attested slot TTL; OpenAI adapter: map soft-cancel semantics to compat layer and propagate resume token via existing stream metadata; KV cache & toolcall: store minimal tombstone with idempotency signature and verify resume token before re-execution; Tests: add end-to-end flaky-network harness that simulates disconnect/resume and verifies toolcall deduplication; Docs: add api/streaming/interrupts.md and update OpenAI compatibility notes. Checklist: [x] Design doc ENG-1284 linked; [x] Unit tests for negotiation, token expiry, idempotency; [x] E2E integration test simulating reconnect; [x] Backwards-compatible mapping in openai-compat adapter; [x] Feature-flag gate. Commits (summary): 1) preflight negotiation and headers handling (runtime/session_manager.go + api/http_headers.go); 2) soft-cancel handshake and resume token plumbing (runtime/stream_lifecycle.go + protocol/soft_cancel.md); 3) toolcall tombstone & idempotency guard (runtime/toolrunner.go); 4) openai adapter mapping + docs (adapters/openai_compat.go + docs/streaming/interrupts.md); 5) tests and flaky harness (tests/stream_recovery_test.go). Files changed (high-level): runtime/session_manager.go (new negotiation flow + validation); runtime/stream_lifecycle.go (soft-cancel/resume state machine); runtime/toolrunner.go (tombstone & reentrancy guard); adapters/openai_compat.go (header mapping, resume token translation); docs/streaming/interrupts.md (protocol description & examples); tests/stream_recovery_test.go (e2e harness). Review highlights: Ethan Cole: asked to limit negotiated grace window to 30s default and make tenant-configurable; Priya: added tenant config + LRU TTL; Marisol Chen: asked to call out failure modes for expired tokens and metrics; Priya: added session.resume_accept and session.resume_reject metrics and audit log for rejected tokens; Diego Alvarez: reran CI and requested jitter in tests to reduce flakiness; Priya: added randomized jitter and extended timeouts. CI / Checks: go test ./... -> pass (with a single retry for test_stream_teardown); linters -> pass; integration e2e -> pass; load perf quick-run -> warning (~1.8% tail latency uplift under extreme synthetic reconnect patterns). Backward compatibility & rollout: negotiation is optional and ignored by older servers; soft-cancel guarded by runtime.feature.streaming_soft_cancel; openai-compat surfaces feature only for profile >= v1.12. Operational notes: added metrics session.resume_accept and session.resume_reject and recommended alert rate(session.resume_reject[5m]) > 0.05; added runbook docs/oncall/stream_resume_runbook.md. Migration / Data concerns: tombstones stored in in-memory bounded store backed by persisted LRU index; default worst-case tombstones per tenant = 5000 (configurable); increased per-GPU heap reservation for canary nodes. Why different: prior PRs addressed lease refresh & hard-eviction; this change prioritizes client-driven preflight and soft-cancel handshake to permit safe resume without full session rehydration, reducing toolcall duplication and keeping KV cache warm. Merge outcome: merged via squash and rolled to 5% canary for 72h with monitoring; no regressions beyond slight tail latency uplift. Follow-ups: ENG-1290 audit-tool for stale tombstones; perf: evaluate eviction heuristics to reduce 99.9th pct latency; SDK updates: client helper for mobile background soft_cancel (ENG-1312).
